name: Douglas C. Wallace

field_contribution: First author of the 2020 Joint Task Force anaphylaxis practice parameter — the doctrine that intramuscular epinephrine is first-line and antihistamines are not a substitute.

name: Richard S. H. Pumphrey
field_contribution: Author of the landmark fatal-anaphylaxis case series establishing that delayed epinephrine is a recurring feature of deaths — the empirical spine of 'epinephrine first, immediately'.

name: Alexander Y. Walley
field_contribution: Lead author of the Massachusetts study showing community overdose education and naloxone distribution is associated with lower opioid-overdose death rates.

name: David Szpilman
field_contribution: Author of the authoritative NEJM drowning review establishing drowning as a hypoxic arrest (ventilation-priority resuscitation) and retiring the 'drain water from the lungs' myth.

name: Fiona M. Wood
field_contribution: Burns surgeon whose work evidenced that ~20 minutes of cool running water as burn first aid reduces depth, grafting, and scarring — the science behind 'cool water, not butter or ice'.

name: Ian G. Stiell
field_contribution: Creator of the Canadian CT Head Rule and Ottawa rules — validated red-flag criteria translated into lay 'when to go to the ER' guidance.

name: Nora D. Volkow
field_contribution: NIDA director and principal architect of the brain-disease model of addiction (the three-stage circuit framework) and lead author of the canonical cannabis-harms review.

name: Lee N. Robins
field_contribution: Her Vietnam-veteran heroin follow-up (most quit on return home, untreated, without relapse) is the empirical spine of the context-and-choice critique of addiction.

name: Luis Sordo / Maria A. Sordo
field_contribution: Led the meta-analysis showing opioid agonist maintenance (methadone/buprenorphine) roughly halves all-cause and overdose mortality — the most consequential treatment-mortality finding in addiction medicine.

name: Stephen Rollnick
field_contribution: Co-originator of motivational interviewing — the collaborative, non-confrontational method that is the evidence-based refutation of the 'break down the denial / wait for rock bottom' model.

name: Marc N. Potenza
field_contribution: Lead of the authoritative gambling-disorder primer — the science behind the only broadly-accepted behavioral addiction (shared reward biology, DSM-5 reclassification).
